segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "authentication" when I talk about my computer project. I say "authorization" when I talk about my computer project. I say "user account" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use authentication, authorization, and user account. At the end, I say: I can use authentication clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“身份验证与权限”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。authentication：身份验证，确认用户是谁的过程。示例：I learned how to use "authentication" in a computer task.authorization：授权，确认用户可以做什么的过程。示例：I learned how to use "authorization" in a computer task.user account：用户账号，用来识别和保存个人信息的身份。示例：I learned how to use "user account" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

授权，确认用户可以做什么的过程
用户账号，用来识别和保存个人信息的身份

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“身份验证与权限”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。login session：登录会话，用户登录后持续一段时间的访问状态。示例：I learned how to use "login session" in a computer task.access permission：访问权限，允许用户读取或修改某项资源的规则。示例：I learned how to use "access permission" in a computer task.sign out：退出登录，结束当前登录会话。示例：I learned how to use "sign out" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

I say "I'm allergic to this medicine." in a daily conversation. I say "I need to see a doctor." in a daily conversation. I tell my teammate: Today I use Are there any side effects?, I'm allergic to this medicine., and I need to see a doctor.. At the end, I say: I can use Are there any side effects? clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise GitHub English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I use "access token" when I work with my team. I use "personal access token" when I work with my team. I use "repository secret" when I work with my team. I tell my teammate: Today I use access token, personal access token, and repository secret. At the end, I say: I can use access token clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“Token、Secret 与权限”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。access token：访问令牌，代替密码授权程序访问服务的字符串。示例：Our team uses "access token" to keep the project clear.personal access token：个人访问令牌，代表个人账号调用 GitHub 的令牌。示例：Our team uses "personal access token" to keep the project clear.repository secret：仓库机密，供自动化任务安全使用的敏感值。示例：Our team uses "repository secret" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

hard.def: 访问令牌，代替密码授权程序访问服务的字符串
个人访问令牌，代表个人账号调用 GitHub 的令牌
仓库机密，供自动化任务安全使用的敏感值

At the end, I say: I can use workflow permission clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“Token、Secret 与权限”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。workflow permission：工作流权限，限制自动化可以执行的操作。示例：Our team uses "workflow permission" to keep the project clear.secret scanning：机密扫描，自动发现意外提交的密钥。示例：Our team uses "secret scanning" to keep the project clear.revoke a token：撤销令牌，让已有令牌立即失效。示例：Our team uses "revoke a token" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
